scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You know... this place doesn't seem to be safe for you. Please return to me once you have achieved ^0000FFLevel 99^000000 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你知道吗...这个地方对你来说似乎并不安全。请等你达到^0000FF99级^000000或以上时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我不确定你是否已经彻底探索了时空裂缝。也许你应该再深入看看。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
What did you see in there?!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你在里面看到了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她是十二瓦尔基里之一。我没想到她的故事竟然如此悲惨...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
看来你造成了她和父亲之间巨大的误会。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你不应该为发生的一切，或者流下的鲜血而自责。看来那天的事件是命中注定的，无论谁在那里都会发生。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
请不要告诉任何人你时间旅行的冒险经历。我们不能让任何人觉得你比老雷恩更重要。而且他们也不会相信这种故事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我想在你上次进入裂缝后大约20小时，它会稳定到足以让你再次穿越。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我想在你上次进入裂缝后大约20小时，它会稳定到足以让你再次穿越。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回忆 ] 紧急冷却已解除。现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You wish to relive the past again?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你想再次重温过去吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
请通过次元装置探索，并向我汇报你在里面发现的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Though I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
不过我要提醒你。它可能不稳定。请确保尽快进入。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
嗯...我不能强迫你。但如果你找到了勇气，请再来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我不确定你是否已经彻底探索了时空裂缝。也许你应该再深入看看。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回忆 ] 紧急冷却已解除。现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我不确定你是否已经彻底探索了时空裂缝。也许你应该再深入看看。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Give up
scripts.translation: 放弃

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am glad to hear that! Maybe someday you can be as brave as old Leon the Lion!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
听到这个我很高兴！也许有一天你能像老雷恩狮子一样勇敢！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
嗯...我不能强迫你。但如果你找到了勇气，请再来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
What did you see in there?!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你在里面看到了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她是十二瓦尔基里之一。我没想到她的故事竟然如此悲惨...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
看来你造成了她和父亲之间巨大的误会。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你不应该为发生的一切，或者流下的鲜血而自责。看来那天的事件是命中注定的，无论谁在那里都会发生。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
请不要告诉任何人你时间旅行的冒险经历。我们不能让任何人觉得你比老雷恩更重要。而且他们也不会相信这种故事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我想在你上次进入裂缝后大约20小时，它会稳定到足以让你再次穿越。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Excuse my rudeness! I am Pon de Leon, the famous adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
抱歉我的无礼！我是庞·德·雷恩，著名的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
My friends call me Leon the Lion! For my tough appearance and attitude. Plus I have quite the bite!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我的朋友们叫我雷恩狮子！因为我的外表和态度都很强硬。而且我的狠咬也很厉害！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You know, this is such a strange location...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
你知道吗，这是一个非常奇怪的地方...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
As you explore it you start to see cracks in space and time. Each one covered by a dimensional device.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
当你探索它时，你会开始看到时空裂缝。每一个都被一个次元装置覆盖。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
For example, I think I have caught glimpses of Payon through the one closest to us. But it doesn't seem right. Almost like it is a little bit older than it should be.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
例如，我想我通过离我们最近的那个看到了斐扬。但看起来不对劲。几乎像是它比应该的更古老一点。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I want to explore it, but with my old age and my knees I don't seem to be quite up to the task.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我想去探索那里，但考虑到我的年纪和膝盖的状况，我似乎不太适合亲自前往。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
So, I would like to ask something of you.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
所以，我想拜托你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
请通过次元装置探索，并向我汇报你在里面发现的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Though; I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
不过；我要提醒你。那里可能很不稳定。请确保你能尽快进入。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hey! You are too young to be playing with that! Come back when you are at least ^0000FFLevel 99^000000!
scripts.translation:
[次元装置]
嘿！你还太小了，不能玩这个！等你至少达到^0000FF99级^000000再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Before you go playing around with that; Why don't you come over here and talk to me?
scripts.translation:
[次元装置]
在你到处乱玩之前；何不先过来和我谈谈？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Before you enter you need to organize a party! Don't you know how? Type /organize PARTYNAMEHERE.
scripts.translation:
[次元装置]
在进入之前你需要组建一个队伍！你不知道怎么操作吗？输入 /organize PARTYNAMEHERE。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The dimensional device boots up cleanly. Use the device to enter the crack in space and time.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000次元装置启动正常。使用装置进入时空裂缝。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
The memorial dungeon {0} does not exist.
The party leader did not generate the dungeon yet.
scripts.translation:
记忆地下城 {0} 不存在。
队伍首领尚未生成地下城。

scripts.text: Only the registered members can enter the instance {0}.
scripts.translation: 只有注册的成员才能进入副本 {0}。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The party leader did not boot up the dimensional device.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000队伍首领尚未启动次元装置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
我想在你上次进入裂缝后大约20小时，它会稳定到足以让你再次穿越。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回忆 ] 紧急冷却已解除。现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里？

scripts.text:
[A Girl]
Hello! This is the village of Payon. You don't seem to be from around here...
scripts.translation:
[一个女孩]
你好！这里是斐扬的村庄。你看起来不像是这里的人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you from here? You don't seem to quite match the locals either.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是这里的人吗？你看起来也不太像当地人。

scripts.text:
[A Girl]
Yes! I was born here! My name is Sara, Sara Irene!
scripts.translation:
[一个女孩]
是的！我出生在这里！我叫莎拉，莎拉·艾琳！

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
My father is doyen of this village! I just take after my mother.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我父亲是这个村庄的元老！我只是随了我母亲。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! I am sorry! Uh... Why are you standing out here all alone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！对不起！呃...你一个人站在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I am waiting for my father. He said that he will be here soon.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我在等我的父亲。他说他很快就会回来。

scripts.text: ^FF0000An older man exits the house. Sara's face brightens at the sight of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一位年长的男子走出房子。莎拉看到他的脸顿时亮了起来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Hi Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sweetheart you look so happy.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
亲爱的，你看起来很开心。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
You said you would come back soon! I waited for you and you lied!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
你说过会很快回来的！我等了你好久，你竟然骗我！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sweetheart, I am sorry I made you wait so long. The meeting with the village elders took longer than expected.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
亲爱的，对不起让你等了这么久。和村里长老们的会议比预计的时间要长。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I hate those old fogeys.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我讨厌那些老顽固。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Don't say that sweetheart... Who is this with you?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
别这么说，亲爱的...这位是谁？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Doyen Irene stares at you with fire in his eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000元老 艾琳眼中闪烁着怒火，死死地盯着你。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara starts humming and singing softly to herself. She picks some wild flowers nearby and presents them to the Doyen.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉开始轻声哼唱。她摘了一些附近的野花，递给元老。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Here you go daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
给你，爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Oh Sara, may I have them?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
哦，莎拉，我可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Of course silly daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
当然可以啦，笨蛋爸爸！

scripts.text: ^FF0000After being given the flowers the Doyen's mood seems to greatly improve.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000收到花后，元老的心情似乎好了很多。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Alright my princess, where should we go now?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
好了，我的公主，我们现在去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Oh daddy! Lets go to the top of that hill over there!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
哦，爸爸！我们去那边的小山丘顶上吧！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Hah! Ok, hold onto me tight!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
哈哈！好，抓紧我！

scripts.text: ^FF0000As they wander off you hear strange voices from around the corner...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000当他们走远时，你听到拐角处传来奇怪的声音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Old Man]
I can feel Sara's power growing. We cannot just stand by and let her achieve her full potential!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我能感觉到莎拉的力量在增长。我们不能坐视不管，让她发挥全部潜力！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
She was born under a bad sign and her mother isn't even one of us!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
她生在不吉的命格下，而且她母亲甚至不是我们的人！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
Someday she will cause blood to flow in our streets.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
总有一天，她会让我们街道血流成河。

scripts.text:
[Strange Old Man]
We have to do something before the Holy creatures select her. I asked 'HIM' to take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
在神圣生物选中她之前，我们必须做点什么。我已经请“他”去处理了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
We will see... I look forward to hearing the bad news that has befallen her...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
我们会看到的...我很期待听到降临在她身上的噩耗...

scripts.text: ^FF0000The old men wander off. It seems Sara might be in danger. We have to do something!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000老人们走远了。莎拉似乎正处于危险之中。我们必须做点什么！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Oh! Hello again! I remember you, what's up?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
哦！又见面了！我记得你，有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I am here to give flowers to my mommy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我来给妈妈送花！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara leaps forward to open the door, flowers at the ready.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉跳上前去开门，手里拿着花。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mom! Dad! Look what I found!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
妈妈！爸爸！看我找到了什么！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The door opens to reveal a woman near death laying on the floor and the Doyen standing over the woman with a bloody sword.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000门开了，里面躺着一位奄奄一息的女子，元老正手持染血的剑站在她身旁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text:
[Sara's Mother]
Sara...Ru-...away...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉的母亲]
莎拉...快...跑...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text: ^FF0000A gem rolls from the woman's hand and comes to a rest in front of Sara. Unconsciously Sara reaches down and picks up the gem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一颗宝石从女子手中滚落，停在莎拉面前。莎拉下意识地伸手捡起了它。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000The Doyen turns around and notices Sara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000元老转过身，注意到了莎拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Ahh Sara! I was just looking for you...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
啊，莎拉！我正好在找你...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text: Escape with Sara.
scripts.translation: 带着莎拉逃跑

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Guards! GUARDS!! There is a murderer here! Catch him!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
卫兵！卫兵！！这里有杀人犯！抓住他！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The sound of many pairs of boots can be heard running outside!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000外面传来许多双靴子奔跑的声音！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mommy NO!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
妈妈不！！！！！！！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara runs away and the sound of the guards is getting closer...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉跑开了，卫兵的脚步声越来越近...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mommy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
妈妈！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sara...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
莎拉...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
No!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
不！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
I have been looking for you Sara. Please come with daddy, it is very dangerous here!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
我一直在找你，莎拉。请跟爸爸走，这里很危险！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't let you take Sara!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不会让你带走莎拉的！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
The murderer is here! Guards! We will finish him once and for all!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
凶手在这里！卫兵们！
我们要彻底解决他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sara... run! Save yourself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莎拉...快跑！
救你自己！

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...okay.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...好的。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
You... were too strong for me.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
你...太强了。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Why... *hack* are you trying to kill my wife and daughter?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
为什么... *咳* 你要杀我的妻子和女儿？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you talking about? We saw you standing over Sara's mother with your sword COVERED in blood!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在说什么？
我们看见你站在莎拉母亲身边，
你的剑上沾满了血！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
You... think I killed Sara's mother?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
你...认为我杀了莎拉的亲生母亲？

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
She *cough* had already been stabbed by an assassin. I slew him *hack* that is why my blade was covered in blood...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
她 *咳* 已经被刺客刺中了。
我杀死了他 *咳* 所以我的剑上才沾满了血...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Thinking back, you seem to recall another body laying in the left corner of the room. Maybe that was the assassin the Doyen is talking about.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000回想起来，你似乎记得房间角落里还有一具尸体。也许那就是元老所说的刺客。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
If... you are the not the assassin sent to kill my wife and daughter, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
如果...你不是那个被派来杀我妻女的刺客，那你到底是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am just an adventurer who was passing through. I heard some strange men plotting their deaths and needed to intervene.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是个路过的冒险者。
我听到几个可疑的人在密谋杀害她们，所以不得不介入。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
If... you are telling the truth... forgive me. I thought you were one of them.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
如果...你说的是真的...请原谅我。我以为你是他们中的一员。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Strange men? ...I bet they were some of the village elders. Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
可疑的人？...我敢打赌他们是村里的长老。唉...

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
There might be more assassins so we have to find Sara as fast as we can!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
可能还有更多的刺客，我们必须尽快找到莎拉！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sara believes that you killed her mother. We need to tell her the truth!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莎拉认为你杀了她的母亲。我们需要告诉她真相！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
We must do our best to find her. Lets split up and search for her. Please help me find my daughter and explain everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
我们必须尽力找到她。我们分头去找吧。请帮我找到我的女儿，并向她解释一切。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you are about to call out to Sara, a sudden blow knocks you down from behind.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000当你正要呼喊莎拉时，背后突然遭到一击，你倒在了地上。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
The time travellers cannot interfere any longer. You cannot stop us from meeting Sara.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
时间旅行者不能再干涉了。你们无法阻止我们见到莎拉。

scripts.text:
[?????]
You should go back to the time where you belong.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
你们应该回到属于你们的时间去。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you fall to the ground, two dark figures approach Sara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000当你倒在地上时，两个黑影向莎拉逼近。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
A girl full of betrayal, despair, and hate. We will guide you to your ultimate fate.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
一个充满背叛、绝望与仇恨的女孩。我们将引导你走向最终的命运。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sara Irene, 'he' will make your dreams come true.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
莎拉·艾琳，“他”会让你的梦想成真。

scripts.text: ^FF0000One of the cloaked strangers covers Sara with their cloak and all three figures disappear.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000其中一名蒙面陌生人用斗篷遮住莎拉，三人随即消失。^000000
